entries.29573741acfeec94: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company, as a holding company, has as its basic role formulating group-wide management policies and management plans based on them, and effectively using group management resources to pursue continuous enhancement of corporate value. The group's main businesses are wholesale sales of prescription drugs, prescription diagnostic reagents, medical devices and materials centered on Alfresa Corporation; wholesale sales of over-the-counter drugs and other products centered on Alfresa Healthcare Corporation; manufacturing and sales of drugs, prescription diagnostic reagents, medical devices, tools and active pharmaceutical ingredients centered on Alfresa Pharma Corporation; and operation of dispensing pharmacies centered on Apokurito Corporation. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,104,064 million (up 4.8% year on year).
entries.2e70a8fceafd7ddf: A reportable segment that wholesales ethical pharmaceuticals, clinical laboratory reagents, and medical devices and materials to medical institutions and others; among the four reportable segments, it is the one with the largest revenue from external customers.
entries.3753cc13f9acee93: A category that the securities report describes as "business segments not included in reportable segments," and it includes the regenerative medicine-related business. The Company's wholly owned subsidiary Cell Resources Corporation is focusing on the manufacture and storage of master cells and the development of the CMO/CDMO business. The net sales field for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is printed as "－", and no amount is disclosed (it does not state zero). The operating loss was ¥1,099 million, and the securities report states that this was because business investment costs, such as personnel expenses and research and development expenses aimed at winning orders, were recorded in selling, general and administrative expenses. This category was newly established at the beginning of the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.4988850e837c67e1: Ethical Pharmaceuticals and Other Wholesale Business
entries.5884bab5efbd6e91: A reportable segment that mainly operates dispensing pharmacies, carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Apocreate Corporation.
entries.5d1b00bdecf41e3c: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, medical diagnostic reagents, active pharmaceutical ingredients, medical devices and supplies, and more. It is carried out by Alfresa Pharma Corporation and Alfresa Fine Chemical Corporation (active pharmaceutical ingredients for prescription drugs), and by Qingdao Naisike Medical Materials Co., Ltd. in China (medical devices and supplies), among others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥37,181 million (¥37,690 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥1,203 million (¥1,294 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report states that sales decreased because of lower pharmaceutical sales due to drug price revisions and the effect of the selected treatment system for long-listed products introduced in October 2024, and a decline in demand for diagnostic agents, despite growth in active pharmaceutical ingredient sales and efforts to hold down selling, general and administrative expenses. In February 2026, it launched in Japan Nefy Nasal Spray, an adjunctive treatment for anaphylaxis.
entries.630f4e4ef85b339e: The annual securities report states that there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of total sales.
entries.6e8b3b59fc624b6a: Sales from wholesale of prescription drugs, prescription diagnostic reagents, and medical devices and materials (Prescription Drug Wholesale Business)
entries.6ee75f477dc1bcf0: The main customers are medical institutions, and the annual securities report states in its business risks that a trading practice continues in which wholesalers deliver products to medical institutions for a certain period after drug price revisions, before prices are determined, with price negotiations taking place afterward. Because drugs are life-related products that cannot tolerate delivery delays, the company handles supply through distribution centers and other facilities nationwide. The annual securities report states that the Prescription Drug Wholesale Business achieved high revenue growth through sales channels to clinics. In the Dispensing Pharmacy Business, Apokurito Corporation operates pharmacies with the aim of becoming “family pharmacies.”
entries.78ab8327ef5d0660: Drugs, prescription diagnostic reagents, medical devices and tools, active pharmaceutical ingredients (manufacturing and sales)
entries.8669c35c9d03baee: This reportable segment wholesales prescription drugs, medical testing reagents, and medical devices and materials to medical institutions and others, and it has the largest external customer revenue of the four reportable segments. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,763,082 million (¥2,621,062 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (on an operating profit basis) was ¥33,297 million (¥33,055 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). Regional wholesalers, centered on Alfresa Co., Ltd. and including Shikoku Alfresa Co., Ltd., TS Alfresa Co., Ltd., Meisho Co., Ltd., Ryuyaku Co., Ltd. and Tohoku Alfresa Co., Ltd., are responsible for this segment. The securities report states that, although the business environment was difficult, with the negative impact of the mid-year revision of drug prices in April 2025 and soaring logistics costs, including labor costs, it achieved revenue growth exceeding market growth through the promotion of its Neo Primary strategy and an increase in the handling of limited-distribution products such as specialty drugs.
entries.8b924f35dfe1c4f0: This reportable segment wholesales general medicines, health foods and healthcare-related products, and is handled by its consolidated subsidiary Alfresa Healthcare Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥266,626 million (¥265,275 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (on an operating profit basis) was ¥3,012 million (¥2,950 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report states that, in addition to revenue growth from expanding sales channels, logistics costs rose but the company focused on cost control, so both revenue and profit exceeded the previous year.
entries.90565e1a66f62e19: Other Businesses (including the regenerative medicine-related business)
entries.9111bd28f4e41549: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,164 million (down 5.0% year on year), and ordinary profit was ¥38,634 million (down 4.6% year on year). Because the company recorded extraordinary gains, including gain on sale of investment securities of ¥25,331 million from reducing policy-held shares, profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥41,746 million (up 52.4% year on year), exceeding ordinary profit. The annual securities report states that selling, general and administrative expenses include business investment costs of ¥2,173 million, including those related to the Regenerative Medicine-Related Business and biosimilar facility development, and that operating profit excluding these costs was ¥38,337 million (up 0.7% year on year).
entries.9c4b249e2f39e6d9: Prescription drugs, prescription diagnostic reagents, medical devices and materials (wholesale)
entries.a9aeef899ad80d97: The annual securities report states that the “25-27 Medium-Term Management Plan” sets out the group's aim to seamlessly provide, across the whole group, drug introduction and development, manufacturing through logistics and sales, post-marketing surveys, and last-mile delivery. This approach is called TSCS (Total Supply Chain Service). In January 2026, the company began providing the “PATH-Solution” platform service, which supports the entry into Japan of overseas emerging biopharmaceutical companies and others. In November 2025, the company resolved that four companies, including itself, would enter into an agreement concerning the establishment of a joint venture to manufacture active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations of biosimilars (follow-on biologics).
entries.abd8f218814bfe74: Pharmaceuticals (with central nervous system disorders as the main area)
entries.ae4ef8d30004e1cf: The company is a holding company with its head office in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo; as of March 31, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 12,525 (3,085 temporary employees are excluded from this figure), and there are 17 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]]. The [[term:segment|reportable segments]] consist of four segments, namely the Prescription Drug Wholesale Business, the Self-Medication Wholesale Business, the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Business and the Dispensing Pharmacy Business, plus an “Other” category that includes the Regenerative Medicine-Related Business. In June 2025, the company transitioned from a company with a Board of Corporate Auditors to a company with an Audit and Supervisory Committee.
entries.b7f11ed0f9f3f9d1: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, medical diagnostic reagents, active pharmaceutical ingredients, medical devices and supplies, and more. It is carried out by Alfresa Pharma Corporation and Alfresa Fine Chemical Corporation (active pharmaceutical ingredients for prescription drugs), and by Qingdao Naisike Medical Materials Co., Ltd. in China (medical devices and supplies), among others.

entries.e8bebee871262382: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,104,064 million (up 4.8% year on year). Revenue from external customers was ¥2,763,082 million for the Prescription Drug Wholesale Business, ¥266,626 million for the Self-Medication Wholesale Business, ¥37,181 million for the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Business and ¥37,174 million for the Dispensing Pharmacy Business, with wholesale accounting for the large majority. The annual securities report states in its business risks that prescription drug prices are official prices set by notification of the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare, which effectively function as the upper limit of sales prices, and that downward revisions are made periodically. In April 2025, there was an interim-year revision of drug prices.

entries.f9b96f4bdccf2473: Over-the-counter drugs, health foods, healthcare-related products (wholesale)
entries.f9ff57d7b9a09b0f: Revenue from manufacturing and sales of drugs, diagnostic reagents, active pharmaceutical ingredients and others (Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Business)
entries.fb799ebf6d82e16e: A reportable segment that mainly operates dispensing pharmacies, carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Apocreate Corporation. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, it was renamed from the former "Medical-Related Business." Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥37,174 million (¥37,023 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), and segment profit (operating profit basis) was ¥499 million (¥596 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report states that profit was lower than in the previous fiscal year because of the negative effect of drug price revisions and higher purchase costs, despite efforts to enhance services for patients and improve pharmacists' productivity.
